description: This Java class 'CatalogUrlSeoTransform' provides methods for generating SEO-friendly URLs for products and categories, initializing category maps, and handling URL forwarding and rewriting within an e-commerce platform. It integrates with OFBiz components and uses regex for URL validation.

classes.name: CatalogUrlSeoTransform
classes.description: A utility class for generating SEO-friendly URLs, initializing category maps, and handling URL forwarding for products and categories in an OFBiz-based e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the provided map, handling different object types.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a Writer that processes the URL generation logic during template rendering.

methods.name: isCategoryMapInitialed
methods.description: Checks if the category maps have been initialized.

methods.name: getCategoryNameIdMap
methods.description: Returns the map of category names to IDs.

methods.name: getCategoryIdNameMap
methods.description: Returns the map of category IDs to names.

methods.name: initCategoryMap
methods.description: Initializes category name and ID maps based on database data.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Constructs a product URL based on request context, product ID, and category info.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Constructs a category URL with optional view parameters and search string.

methods.name: getNiceName
methods.description: Converts a string into a URL-friendly, hyphen-separated, lowercase name.

methods.name: forwardProductUri
methods.description: Forwards the request to a product URL if matching URL patterns are found.

methods.name: forwardUri
methods.description: Handles URL forwarding based on pattern matching and URL structure.

methods.name: forwardCategoryUri
methods.description: Forwards the request to a category URL based on pattern matching.
